tests.name: src/indexer/parser/__tests__/typescript-module-level-calls.test.ts: calls in a program-level expression statement (including nested describe/test callbacks), a non-function program-level or exported initializer, other program-level statements and export default, in both TypeScript (.ts) and JavaScript (.js) sources, are CALLS from the file entity; calls in function declarations, class methods, exported functions and classes and function-valued declarators keep their caller and are not credited to the file; built-ins are still skipped; a module-level HTTP call is a CALLS_HTTP from the file entity
